strategies.name: Wrong context instruction in ComputeNumSignBits
strategies.rationale: The patch changes SimplifyDemandedUseBits to take a SimplifyQuery parameter instead of a context instruction. When ComputeNumSignBits is called with Q.CxtI, it uses the wrong context instruction (the original instruction being simplified) instead of the current instruction being analyzed. This can lead to incorrect sign bit computation when assumptions or dominance information depends on the correct context.
strategies.expected_issue: Incorrect optimization due to wrong context instruction in sign bit computation
